title: Sandbox Host: Wire sandbox-host binary to service + RPC
description: Signoff gap from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.md and 11-sandbox-host-service-test-harness.md: cmd/sandbox-host is still a skeleton. Implement full binary wiring: config loading (flags/env/file), instantiate ZFS+gVisor managers and SandboxHostService, expose RPC services, and graceful shutdown semantics under SIGTERM with in-flight drain + pause behavior.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Implemented cmd/sandbox-host wiring: added config loading (flags/env), CLI manager + gVisor manager instantiation, SandboxHostService + RPC server initialization, Connect transport handler registration, auth hook support, and graceful SIGTERM shutdown with HTTP drain + service shutdown. Added config parser tests and transport/server tests; all relevant tests pass with -race.
